brand.name: Linear
brand.tagline: The product development system for teams and agents
brand.elevatorPitch: Linear is a purpose-built system for planning and building products, designed for workflows shared by teams and agents. Bring customer feedback, decisions, and code into one place to restore momentum and ship with focus.
brand.boilerplate: About Linear: Founded in 2019, Linear is a purpose-built product development system where teams and agents work together in a shared, structured environment. More than 40,000 companies, including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp, use Linear to plan, build, and ship products. Its team is distributed across North America and Europe, with a focus on fast execution and software craftsmanship.
brand.description: Purpose-built for planning and building products with AI agents.

voice.summary: Calmly ambitious and technically fluent. Linear pairs a clear thesis about the future of product development with concrete workflow language, restrained confidence, and a deep concern for craftsmanship.

traits.name: Future-facing, grounded in systems
traits.description: Frames AI as a structural change in product development, then explains the shared environment needed to make it work.
traits.do: Connect statements about the AI era to specific changes in context, coordination, or execution.
traits.dont: Promise an undefined AI revolution or present agents as magic.

evidence.quote: AI increases what teams can create, but it also raises the bar for clarity and coordination.
A purpose-built system where teams and agents operate together in a shared, structured environment.

traits.name: Momentum without noise
traits.description: Uses direct verbs and operational outcomes to describe speed as focused progress, not frantic activity.
traits.do: Name what becomes faster and which friction is removed.
traits.dont: Use breathless urgency, exclamation-heavy copy, or speed claims detached from quality.

evidence.quote: Reduces noise and restores momentum to help teams ship with high velocity and focus.
Keep PRs moving without sacrificing quality.

traits.name: Craft-led conviction
traits.description: Treats software quality as a deliberate practice, extending from foundations to small details.
traits.do: Describe the care, decisions, and standards behind the work.
traits.dont: Equate quality with generating more output or adding more features.

evidence.quote: What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.
We are looking for people who share our passion for software craftsmanship and getting even the smallest details right.

traits.name: Direct and technically specific
traits.description: Assumes a product-building audience and explains work through recognizable artifacts and actions.
traits.do: Use precise workflow terms and get to the practical point.
traits.dont: Replace concrete actions with vague business jargon or lengthy introductory framing.

evidence.quote: Synthesize customer feedback, draft PRDs, and delegate issues.
Get to the point and assume good intentions.

styleRules: Use sentence case for headings; keep headings compact and centered on a capability or outcome.
Pair short declarative headlines with explanatory sentences around 20–25 words; retain technical detail when it adds precision.
Lead product copy with Linear, the system, or the action; use second person sparingly and first-person plural mainly for company perspectives.
Use periods and restrained punctuation. Avoid routine exclamation marks and reserve questions for purposeful prompts.
Use established product and engineering terms such as PRDs, PRs, triage, and code reviews rather than replacing them with vague abstractions.
Write Linear with a capital L, not “Linear app”; capitalize dedicated releases as proper nouns and express numerical proof with exact figures.

pillars.headline: One system for teams and agents
pillars.message: Keep people and agents working from the same context, priorities, and structure.

proof.quote: It provides a shared product development system, where teams and agents work from the same context, priorities, and structure.
Customer feedback, decisions, and code all live in one place, so everyone works from the same context.

pillars.headline: From context to execution
pillars.message: Turn conversations, customer feedback, and plans into actionable work connected to product priorities.

proof.quote: Automatically turn conversations and customer feedback into actionable issues that are instantly routed, labeled, and prioritized for the right team.
AI coding accelerates individuals. Linear ensures their work is tied to team context and company priorities.

pillars.headline: Speed with focus and control
pillars.message: Remove operational friction so teams can move quickly without losing alignment or quality.

proof.quote: Triage, routing, labeling, and updates happen automatically, so teams can focus on building.
Streamline code reviews with clear diffs, better context, and fewer back-and-forth comments.

pillars.headline: Purpose-built craftsmanship
pillars.message: Build product tools around the practices of strong teams and a lasting commitment to software quality.

proof.quote: Linear is shaped by the practices and principles of world-class product teams.
A tool with unparalleled speed, focus, and design.
